positive.prompt: My AGENTS.md is bloated and contradicts CLAUDE.md. Audit and consolidate them.
Find stale commands and misplaced subsystem guidance in our agent docs.
Standardize our nested agent instructions and duplicated repo skills.

negative.prompt: Set up agent documentation for this empty repository.
negative.reason: Initialization belongs to agentify-repo; there is nothing to audit yet.

negative.prompt: Condense this user-facing README without changing its meaning.
negative.reason: Copy-editing human-facing prose, not auditing agent instruction files.

evals.prompt: Audit the supplied repository for stale, duplicated, contradictory, or poorly scoped agent instructions. Do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: A file-quality report and section verdict table with evidence, projected line counts, and no unapproved edits.
expectations: Uses the manifest and CI as static evidence without executing repo-owned commands
Keeps the security invariant and unresolved incident-born gotcha
Proposes compatible native scoping for Codex, Claude, and Copilot rather than a nested AGENTS.md alone
Links or moves duplicated setup material instead of deleting the only copy
Shows targeted proposed diffs and requests approval before changing files

evals.prompt: Consolidate the divergent release skills while preserving support for every configured tool. Stop after the proposal.
evals.expected_output: A safe consolidation proposal with one canonical skill source and verified tool adapters.
expectations: Inspects whether files and skill directories are copies, symlinks, or divergent, including bundled resources, before proposing changes
Preserves the repository's established canonical location when it already works
Proposes moving content before removing duplicates after approval
Explains how each resulting adapter will be verified after approval
Reports current and projected file or line counts without claiming edits occurred
